caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a backrest, two armrests, and a flat seat. The bench is composed primarily of light brown wood, with visible wood grain and shaded areas suggesting variations in the wood's surface. The backrest features three vertical, elaborately carved wooden slats, evenly spaced and attached to horizontal rails at the top and bottom. The armrests are curved and extend outward, supported by straight legs at the front corners. The top corners of the backrest posts are slightly pointed and irregular. The lower front edge of the bench has a simple decorative cut-out pattern. The bench is situated against a plain, off-white background, and the artist's signature, "Juanita Ibarra," appears in the lower right corner. The overall composition focuses solely on the bench with no additional objects or background details present.
title: Bench
